lines.text: قوت زنان و کثرت فوائد مطربان و صلاح اهل خواتین و قوت احوال اشراف و کثرت عقد نکاح
lines.en: the strength of women, the abundance of benefits for musicians, the well-being of the people of the harem, the strength of the conditions of the nobles, the abundance of marriage contracts,

lines.text: و بسیاری توالد و تناسل اگر مشتری مستعلی باشد و فور شهادت کاذبه باشد خاصه در
lines.en: and much procreation and reproduction, if Jupiter is elevated. And there will be an abundance of false testimony, especially in

lines.text: عراق عرب و ظلم حکام خوزستان بر رعایا و سیاست نمودن بعضی از ملازمان خود را با رنج
lines.en: Arab Iraq, and the oppression of the rulers of Khuzestan upon the subjects, and the punishing of some of their attendants with suffering

lines.text: از فرزندان و صلاح احوال کشت و زرع و اگر زهره مستعلی بود حرب بود در بابل و قتل یکی
lines.en: from children, and the well-being of the conditions of crops and agriculture. And if Venus is elevated, there will be war in Babylon and the killing of one

lines.text: از اهل دولت و کثرت مرگ گوسفند و بسیاری باران و قلت طعام سیما در میان اهل
lines.en: of the people of the state, and an abundance of death among sheep, and much rain, and a scarcity of food, especially among the people of

lines.text: سواد (قران سعدین در مثلثه خاکی) دلالت کند بر تنگی حال اهل طرب و زینت علما
lines.en: the Sawad. (The conjunction of the two benefics in the earthy triplicity) indicates the distress of the condition of musicians, the adornment of scholars

lines.text: و فقها و میل این طایفه بسیر و شکار و لهو و طرب و برامدن نکاحها و جمعیتهای خیر و
lines.en: and jurists, and the inclination of this group towards travel, hunting, amusement, and music, and the occurrence of marriages and good gatherings, and

lines.text: اجابت دعاها و فراخی و بسیاری نعمتها و شیرینیها و لباسها و اعتدال هوا و تندرستی
lines.en: the answering of prayers, and spaciousness, and an abundance of blessings, sweets, and clothes, and the moderation of the weather, and the health of

lines.text: خلایق و امن و نیکی کشت و زرع و ساختن بقاع خیر و کثرت ضیافتها و رواج بازار اقمشه
lines.en: the creatures, and security, and the goodness of crops and agriculture, and the building of places of goodness, and the abundance of banquets, and the flourishing of the fabric market,

lines.text: و کثرت انصاف در خلایق و رونق دار الشرع و فراغت دواب (و اگر در ثور بود) دلالت
lines.en: and the abundance of justice among the creatures, and the flourishing of the Abode of the Law, and the leisure of beasts of burden. (And if it is in Taurus) it indicates

lines.text: کند بر کثرت نعمت و سلامت کشت و زرع و عفت در زنان و امردان و مطربان و طرب
lines.en: an abundance of blessings, the safety of crops and agriculture, and chastity among women, beardless youths, and musicians, and the joy of

lines.text: وزراء کبار و علما و ساختن الات زینت و کثرت سورها و صحت بیماران و خوشی هوا و
lines.en: great viziers and scholars, and the making of instruments of adornment, and the abundance of feasts, and the health of the sick, and the pleasantness of the weather, and

lines.text: انس و راحت مردم و رونق ابواب البر و هلاك کثیری از مردم خوزستان و مضرت رسیدن
lines.en: the intimacy and comfort of the people, and the flourishing of the doors of righteousness, and the perishing of many of the people of Khuzestan, and harm reaching

lines.text: باهل روم و بفساد امدن اموال ایشان و کثرت توالد و شادی خواتین و حدوث بارندگی
lines.en: the people of Rome, and their wealth coming to ruin, and an abundance of procreation, and the joy of the women of the harem, and the occurrence of rainfall.

lines.text: اگر مشتری مستعلی باشد هلاك اهل خراسان بود و بیماریها و کمی باران و اگر زهره مستعلی
lines.en: If Jupiter is elevated, there will be the perishing of the people of Khorasan, and diseases, and a scarcity of rain. And if Venus is elevated,

lines.text: بود فساد اهل بابل و خوزستان بود و مرگ بزرگی در ان بلاد (و اگر در سنبله بود)
lines.en: there will be corruption among the people of Babylon and Khuzestan, and the death of a great one in those lands. (And if it is in Virgo)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر موت زنان و قتل بعضی از اکابر و حرب میانه دو بزرگ و شدت باد و
lines.en: it indicates the death of women, and the killing of some of the great ones, and war between two great ones, and the intensity of the wind, and

lines.text: ضرر خواتین و مطربان و سلامت غلات و نباتات و ساختن عمارات نو و حکم و صلح
lines.en: harm to the women of the harem and musicians, and the safety of grains and plants, and the building of new edifices, and judgment and peace

lines.text: میان مردم بالضرورة و میل علما و قضاة بطرب و نشاط حرام و اعتدال هوا و میل این
lines.en: among the people by necessity, and the inclination of scholars and judges towards music and forbidden joy, and the moderation of the weather, and the inclination of this

lines.text: طایفه بمطالعه حکمیات و ریاضیات و حکیم فاضل محی الدین مغربی گوید دلالت کند بر
lines.en: group towards the study of philosophical and mathematical sciences. And the learned philosopher Muhyi al-Din al-Maghribi says it indicates

lines.text: عاصی شدن ولایتی از پادشاه روم و شاید که انولایت را تسلیم اعدا نمایند و شادی
lines.en: the rebellion of a province against the king of Rome, and perhaps they will surrender that province to the enemies, and the joy of

lines.text: اهل بابل و بسیاری حیوانات ضاره مثل مار و نقصان زراعت از غلوی طیور و اگر مشتری
lines.en: the people of Babylon, and an abundance of harmful animals like snakes, and a decrease in agriculture due to the excess of birds. And if Jupiter

lines.text: مستعلی بود تعصب اهل روم بود با پادشاه و زیان اهل خوزستان و اگر زهره مستعلی
lines.en: is elevated. There will be the fanaticism of the people of Rome against the king, and loss for the people of Khuzestan. And if Venus is elevated,

sections.en: The conjunction of Venus and Jupiter

summary.headline: Venus–Jupiter Conjunction in Earth Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Venus and Jupiter in the earthy triplicity, Taurus, and Virgo, including effects of either planet’s elevation on rulers, regions, agriculture, weather, warfare, disease, marriage, musicians, scholars, and jurists. Muhyi al-Din al-Maghribi adds predictions concerning Rome, Babylon, Khuzestan, harmful animals, birds, and agriculture.
